rationale: The card's load-bearing behaviour, unchanged by round 8 and still in this branch's diff. On the codex route the bridge fills a schema whose mutationClaim rides in as type ['object','null'], so a fabricated object is schema-valid and, being preferred over the committed artifact at the gate, would shadow the real nomination. forgeAgent discards it in code rather than by instruction. Restoring the bare `return res` reopens exactly that hole: the two adversarial-bridge cases (build round and fix round) go red while the prover suite, which never runs the workflow body, stays green. Round 8's own change is a REMOVAL (the base pinning comes out) plus a two-line refusal, so this remains the behaviour worth proving.
